chronology: Exploratory numerical sensitivity fixed after the complete six-model comparison and signed PCA attribution. No continued NMF fit or its annotations have been inspected. Preserve the original200-iteration cap and its warning.
question: Does additional optimization from the actual capped NMF factors satisfy the declared numerical tolerance, and how does its annotation/association result change? This cannot isolate algorithm superiority or establish biological novelty.

initialization.policy: Read original actual W and H, copy to new arrays and use sklearn NMF init=custom. This is a warm restart, not bit-identical continuation of one uninterrupted fit: sklearn resets its initial-error stopping reference. Report that qualification and all warnings.

execution: Four CPU threads with no other active model fit. At most800 further MU iterations; do not change rank, tolerance, solver or cap after outcomes. Retain initial and final reconstruction errors, actual elapsed fit time, warnings and n_iter. If interrupted before outputs, retain the log; a rerun requires a fresh path and explicit disclosure because no mid-fit optimizer checkpoint exists.
inference: Use unchanged norman_direct_pca.analyze on actual newly joint-fit factors, identical input/control split, discovery-only annotation and9999 within-gemgroup identity permutations. Report all945 new comparisons, all nine panels and annotation failures. Compare to the complete original six-model family using BH over all7*9*105=6615 associations and Holm over all63 identity hypotheses. Preserve original six-model results and newly distinguish seven-arm flags. No favorable-fit selection or replacement of the original capped arm.
interpretation: Numerical tolerance satisfaction is a solver stopping condition, not proof of a global optimum or biological fidelity. This is one warm-start sensitivity with shared cells, unequal capacities and existing cell-dependence limits. If tolerance remains unmet, report the unresolved cap rather than repeatedly tuning settings. No independent replication, mechanism or SAE/NMF superiority follows.
archive: Fresh separate run directory, exclusive model/factor/JSON files. Keep large W/H outside Git; compact complete JSON/log, all6615 comparative rows, source/input/initial/final-model hashes and warnings in Git after actual completion and validation.
